title: The Hollow Archive
author: Xanthe Halloran
blurb: Coral Hartwell, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
